frozen_bundle.reconstruction: Decode each publication content_sha256 from content_store. Build an ordered object with source_parent, source_tree, files; each files element has path then content, in file_order. Serialize as Python json.dumps(object, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), append one LF, and encode UTF-8. This exactly reconstructs the supplied frozen bundle.

source_audit.governance_scope: The numbered retained-research stage closure requirements remain in force where applicable. This bounded analytical publication does not claim to satisfy numbered-stage closure.

manifest.scope: Bounded analytical publication; no numerical campaign, native milestone or numbered-stage certification. Manifest excludes itself.

complete_tree_comparison.method: Compare complete non-truncated entries from both root trees. Equality of mode, type and Git object identity prunes unchanged entries/subtrees. Descend every changed, added or removed tree to leaves. Recompute Git tree hashes of all 21 retrieved complete tree objects using canonical Git ordering and binary entries. No diff truncation or supplied changed-path list is used as the boundary proof.

execution_boundary: Only connector GETs and local metadata parsing, base64 decoding, hashing, serialization, and file/tree comparisons. No scientific module, simulation, numerical campaign, scientific test, historical stack, workflow, remote publication or ref mutation was performed by this auditor.
self_contained_evidence: All independently retrieved source original and seven published file bytes are embedded once by SHA-256 in content_store; every source and publication record refers to that store. Complete required tree entries, commit metadata, comparisons, bindings and the one failed remote retrieval are embedded. Frozen bundle bytes are exactly reconstructible by the included rule. No local-only evidence file is required to evaluate the recorded checks.
